note: XXVI fills B: the plan, the launch, the river by night, the Bistritza, Veresti · Booth style
style: An oil painting in colour of 1893 with the drama of Franklin Booth: monumental scale, deep recession, towering forms, strong value contrast and deep shadow, light breaking through haze, a sense of awe. Loose visible brushstrokes, thick impasto in the lights, thin glazes in the shadows, soft lost edges. Cool late-autumn light by day, no golden glow. Any face is small and unreadable. No text, signature or border.

beats.text: Shot: medium-wide interior, no people. A hotel writing table in Galatz on an October afternoon in 1893 covered with maps, a railway guide, typed sheets and a pen, a tall window with grey river light, deep shadow in the room.

Shot: very wide. Where the river Sereth flows into the Danube near Galatz in 1893, two wide grey rivers meeting among marshes and willows, a long Slovak river boat with a covered cargo being poled upstream, small, great clouds.
Shot: far. A long wooden river boat on the Sereth in late October 1893, a great box under a tarpaulin amidships, boatmen in sheepskins poling it upstream against the current, reedy banks, a grey sky.

Shot: far, exterior, looking in. A tall window of a hotel in Galatz on a grey October afternoon in 1893, figures small and dark inside gathered close together, the river and masts reflected in the glass.
Shot: wide. A small steam launch tied at the Galatz quay in late October 1893, men small on deck loading coal and stores, smoke rising from her short funnel, the wide Danube beyond, a grey afternoon.

Shot: far. A horse market at the edge of Galatz in 1893: strong horses held by grooms, two Englishmen in travelling coats choosing mounts, small, carts and a poplar-lined road, a grey October afternoon.

Shot: very wide. Night on the river Sereth on 30 October 1893: a small steam launch pushing upstream, the red glow of her open furnace door on the water, dark wooded banks, a bright waning moon low behind thin cloud.
Shot: very wide. The dark wooded banks of a Romanian river at night, mist on the water, a single lantern of a moored boat far off, a waning moon behind bare trees.

Shot: very wide. Evening on 1 November 1893 where the river Bistritza runs through a narrowing gorge in the Carpathian foothills, high forested cliffs, a small steam launch small on the dark water, the last cold light on the peaks.
Shot: very wide. Broad daylight on 2 November 1893 on the Bistritza: a fast mountain river between steep forested slopes, a small launch in the stream, a pale clear sky, cold air.

Shot: very wide. The village of Veresti in Romania at noon on 31 October 1893: low whitewashed houses with steep roofs, a dusty road, a wooden church, a light carriage and horses at an inn, the Carpathian mountains blue beyond.

Shot: very wide. A long road climbing from the plain into the Carpathian mountains in early November 1893, a small carriage with four horses far off on it, great forests and peaks, towering clouds, cold light.
